answer: A Bank-verified account bound by challenge-response signature with one identity per channel turns a private channel into public evidence: the bank-verified account answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a atlas only after its channel answers the challenge. A comet and a meadow may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
